# Review-plan Checklist: Streaming AI narrative

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the stream contract, UX and accessibility, content
safety and integration testing, before the review-spec and review-plan gates
**Created**: 2026-09-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) ·
[contracts/openapi-delta.yaml](../contracts/openapi-delta.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Stream contract: completeness and clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is the boundary between "before any text" and "after some text" defined precisely enough to decide which failure path applies (e.g. whether whitespace-only text counts as text)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Is every ending of a narrative (complete, stopped, incomplete for each reason) enumerated in one place, with no ending left implicit? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Plan data-model]
- [x] CHK003 Is the mapping from provider stop conditions other than "finished" and "length cap" (e.g. a refusal) to an ending stated in the spec, or only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Plan R-004]
- [x] CHK004 Is "an empty answer" defined, and is it consistent that it is a pre-text error rather than a complete empty narrative? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK005 Is the inactivity limit's start point specified: from the request, from the provider call, or from the first byte? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Are the requirements for a client disconnect before any text arrives defined, not only after? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified that the incomplete signal is always the last thing sent and that nothing follows it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contract NarrativeEndEvent]
- [x] CHK008 Is the removal of the one-shot response stated as a breaking change, with every consumer of the old response named? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions "Contract change", Clarifications]

## Stream contract: consistency

- [x] CHK009 Is "one list item per group (up to the length limit)" in US2 consistent with the plan's "at most 10 bullets plus a line counting the groups left out"? [Conflict, Spec §US2 AS1, §FR-008, Plan R-007]
- [x] CHK010 Is "low output length" quantified in the spec, or only as a number in the plan? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Plan R-002]
- [x] CHK011 Do US4 AS2 and FR-004 use the same definition of the timeout ("no further text within the configured timeout")? [Consistency, Spec §US4, §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK012 Are "narrative", "summary", "AI summary" and "report" used consistently, with "report" reserved for the deterministic grouped report? [Consistency, Terminology]

## UX: states and interactions

- [x] CHK013 Does US3 AS3 ("a new range stops it the same way", which keeps the text) conflict with the edge case that clears the old summary when the range changes? [Conflict, Spec §US3 AS3, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Is the visible wording of the "stopped" label and of the "incomplete response" notice specified, or left to implementation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK015 Is it specified whether the incomplete notice distinguishes its reasons (provider error, timeout, length, lost connection) or shows one message for all? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is it specified whether the incomplete notice carries a correlation id like the existing pre-text failure notice? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK017 Is the placement of the Stop control relative to the summary button specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK018 Are the button requirements for a pre-text failure (label after the failure notice: "Summarize" or "Regenerate") defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK019 Is the rendering of a formatting mark that is still open while the stream continues (not only at the end) described consistently with SC-006? [Clarity, Spec §US2 AS2, §Edge Cases, §SC-006]

## Accessibility

- [x] CHK020 Is it specified where keyboard focus goes when Stop disappears after it is pressed or when the stream ends? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK021 Are the exact texts of the two announcements specified, including one per ending (complete, stopped, incomplete)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK022 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for the busy indicator, consistent with feature 002's rule? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK023 Is it specified whether a pre-text failure also produces an announcement, or only the existing alert? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007a, §FR-002]

## Content safety and privacy

- [x] CHK024 Is "inert text" defined for each disallowed construct (e.g. does a link show its label, its URL or both)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK025 Do the requirements address formatting or instructions injected through transaction descriptions that reach the provider? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK026 Is it stated what data is sent to the provider and that it is unchanged from feature 001? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 Is the cost exposure of repeated Regenerate presses addressed (accepted, or bounded)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010]

## Integration testing and acceptance criteria

- [x] CHK028 Does FR-012's list of end-to-end cases include the length-cap ending required by FR-010? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK029 Is "forwarded as the provider produces it" stated in a form an automated test can decide without timing guesses? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001, §FR-012, Plan R-011]
- [x] CHK030 Is "a responsive provider" defined for SC-001 and SC-005, so that these criteria can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK031 Can SC-001's "95% of requests" be measured with the manual live-provider check the plan proposes, or does it need a sample size? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Quickstart 6]
- [x] CHK032 Is "well formed" in SC-006 defined? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK033 Is the assumption that the provider's client library honours `LLM_BASE_URL` (needed by FR-012) marked as validated or as a risk? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-013]

## Non-functional: observability

- [x] CHK034 Do the requirements say how a failure after the stream has started is recorded for diagnosis, given that the request itself reports success? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Plan R-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Likely real issues found while writing: CHK009 and CHK013 (conflicts), CHK020 (focus), CHK028 (missing e2e case)
- Review 2026-09-24: CHK002, CHK007, CHK008, CHK010, CHK011, CHK019 and CHK033 were already satisfied. Every other item
  was resolved by a decision recorded in the spec's Clarifications (session 2026-09-24) and applied to the spec, plan,
  research, data model, contract delta and quickstart: FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-007a, FR-008,
  FR-008a, FR-009, FR-012, FR-014a, SC-001, SC-005, SC-006, SC-007, Edge Cases, Assumptions and the Terms note.
